sections.text_helper: Section 11.3.12 "Analog configuration" in chapter 11 (General-purpose I/Os (GPIO)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 346.
sections.section_content:
When the I/O port is programmed as analog configuration:
• The output buffer is disabled.
• The Schmitt trigger input is deactivated, providing zero consumption for every analog
value of the I/O pin. The output of the Schmitt trigger is forced to a constant value (0).
• The weak pull-up is disabled by hardware. The weak pull-down is configurable.
• Read access to the input data register gets the value 0.
The figure below shows the high-Z, analog-input configuration of the I/O port bits.
